brief.goal: Show an AI-generated product film next to the exact product image and prompt that made it.
brief.audience: TikTok / Reels viewers who save prompts; muted autoplay first.
brief.message: This product + this prompt = this film.
assumptions: PLACEHOLDER media: the result clip and product still are cut from the studio's own 3D render. Replace scenes[0].media with your generated film and secondaryMedia with your product photo.
The prompt in body must be the real prompt that produced the result — never a prompt from another product.
Generated footage comes from an external tool (e.g. Higgsfield via /studio-generate, paid, with approval) and is logged in assets-registry.json.

scenes.headline: النتيجة
scenes.body: A brushed-steel monogram letter F standing on a black plinth in a dark studio. Slow orbit from left to front at eye level, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. One warm key light from the left rakes across the steel; a thin rim light separates the edges from the black background. Soft floor reflection, no text, no people, no logo other than the letter. Calm, precise, premium. @Image1 is the exact object: keep its proportions, bevels and finish.
